newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy rates Bank Komunalny as buy.
newsitem.headline: Handlowy rates Bank Komunalny as buy.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA rated Bank Komunalny as a medium-term buy on its financial growth forecast in 1996 and 1997, Handlowy said in a report dated October 10 but released on Monday.
"Taking into account the bank's financial results, its strategy and perspectives of growth, we recommend to medium-term investors to buy the shares," it said.
It said it expected Komunalny's net profit to rise to 7.6 million zlotys in 1996 and 9.4 million zlotys next year, up from last year's 6.5 million.
It saw Komunalny's revenues from interest rising to 14.2 million zlotys in 1996 and to 16 million in 1997, up from 5.9 million.
Handlowy also stressed Komunalny, based in Gdynia, northern Poland, was taking advantage from operating in Pomorze Gdanskie, a region of sea-related economic activity and international trade.
